name: Timestamp Converter
description: Convert between timestamps and dates, with second, millisecond, microsecond, nanosecond units and IANA time zones.

hints.value: Accepts a timestamp or a date string; leave it empty to use the current time.
hints.unit: Without an explicit unit the digit count decides: 13 digits are milliseconds, everything else is seconds.
hints.timezone: Use an IANA zone name such as `Asia/Shanghai`; when empty the server assumes UTC and emits a warning.
hints.output: "Local time" follows the selected zone, while "UTC time" is always Coordinated Universal Time.

faq.q: Why do I see a timezone warning?
faq.a: The server never guesses a time zone. Without one it converts as UTC and reports a `TIMEZONE_ASSUMED` warning next to the result.
It only looks at the digit count: 13 digits mean milliseconds, everything else means seconds. Pick the unit explicitly when precision matters.
